risk-1.description: Only tests, scripts, CI, documentation or benchmark harnesses changed; no production or build-input change.

risk-2.description: Only prover or other non-verifier production code changed, or dependency version/pin-only changes outside the verifier dependency closure.

risk-3.description: Dependency version/pin-only changes in the verifier dependency closure, or scoped code changes. AFFECTS/UNCERTAIN at effective risk-3 stays risk-3 only with at most max_changed_lines added plus removed runtime-code lines across every path whose effective level is 3, including model-raised lower-floor paths, excluding lockfiles and deterministic dependency bumps; non-Rust files conservatively count every non-blank line. Larger changes are risk-4.

risk-4.description: Every runtime-code change on a risk-4-floor path, even if the classifier returns level 1, subject to the documented scanner limits. Only cfg(test)-exclusive code and comment/blank-only changes may go below the floor. Also non-minimal AFFECTS/UNCERTAIN effective-risk-3 changes, protocol changes or otherwise unclassified changes. Requires a current-head maintainer approval.
